title: Textile Design for SHARE NEST Sengawa
description:
This project explores how textile design can influence the atmosphere and user experience of shared workspaces.

In collaboration with SHARE NEST Sengawa, a coworking space in Tokyo, I created a series of textile designs inspired by birds, their habitats, and the surrounding natural environment.

The designs were applied to roller blinds and everyday textile products, introducing gentle colors and playful patterns into the workspace.

Through this project, I explored how textiles can bring warmth, visual interest, and a sense of comfort to spaces used for studying and working. Feedback from visitors also provided valuable insights into how textile design can shape people’s impressions of a space.
